verdict.rationale: The CLI docs mention using Hoppscotch to "run API tests, automate monitoring, and manage collections from your terminal," implying collection runs could be scheduled via CI/cron with the CLI, fitting a ci-scripting workflow. However, there's no evidence of a built-in monitors feature, scheduling UI, or alerting/notification mechanism when APIs break. Missing for 10: dedicated monitor scheduling interface, alert/notification configuration (email/Slack/webhook), and any documented example of a scheduled monitor detecting an API break.
